brief.headline: Order 2,572 units and move 522 between stores to protect Rs 12.3L of sales over the next 14 days.

findings.title: Demand forecast: 13,327 units over the next 28 days (-5%)
findings.body: The last 28 days saw 13,989 units of demand. Largest category moves: graphic tees -10%, jerseys -8%. Calendar ahead: Black Friday.

findings.title: 32 sizes are likely to sell out this week
findings.body: Rs 2.7L of sales is at risk before a supplier order can arrive. The largest single exposure is KERB Regular Zip Hoodie, Black in Indiranagar: 16 units on hand against 14.0 expected this week.

findings.title: Style trends in motion
findings.body: Coquette is emerging (share +4% in 4 weeks, buzz +23%). Gorpcore is rising (share +30% in 4 weeks, buzz +12%).

findings.title: 2 unexplained anomalies in the last 21 days
findings.body: Most recent: Koramangala on 2026-11-11, a drop of 26 units against 62 expected. Orders that depend on an unexplained spike are routed to review.

findings.title: Plan: Rs 18.0L of supplier orders, 24 transfer lanes
findings.body: 503 order lines; 23 need a person's approval. The weekly budget is binding, so Rs 1.9L of the lowest-value units is deferred. Transfers cost Rs 18,498 and are expected to recover Rs 74,933 of margin this week. Sizes above 50% stockout risk fall from 239 to 0.

findings.title: Rs 3.5L of stock is not moving
findings.body: 55 product-store pairs hold more than 12 weeks of cover. The largest is OFFSIDE Regular Hoodie, Black in Hebbal (12 weeks). No orders are placed for these; they are candidates for markdown.

steps.thought: Start with the state of the network and what the calendar holds.
steps.observation: 8 stores. Demand was 13,989 units over the last 28 days; forecast is 13,327 for the next 28 (-5%). Ahead: Black Friday. Stockouts hid an estimated 12.1% of recent demand.

steps.thought: Before trusting recent sales, check whether any of them were abnormal. An unexplained spike would inflate a run-rate and the orders built on it.
steps.observation: 3 anomalies in 21 days, 2 without a known cause.

steps.thought: Check which styles are gaining or losing share, since a trend changes what the same stock is worth four weeks from now.
steps.observation: 4 attributes are moving: coquette (emerging), gorpcore (rising), Baggy Jeans (fading), oversized (fading).

steps.thought: Find where a sale will be lost first: products likely to run out before a supplier order can land.
steps.observation: 32 size-level cells are more likely than not to sell out within 7 days; Rs 2.7L of sales at risk. Largest exposure: KERB Regular Zip Hoodie, Black in Indiranagar.

steps.thought: Understand why KERB Regular Zip Hoodie, Black in Indiranagar is exposed before ordering against it.
steps.observation: KERB Regular Zip Hoodie, Black in Indiranagar: expects 28.3 units in 14 days (P10 14.6, P90 36.6). Drivers: product lifecycle +38%, style trend +25%, recent sales level +8%.

steps.thought: Understand why NAMMA Oversized Fleece, Black in Jayanagar is exposed before ordering against it.
steps.observation: NAMMA Oversized Fleece, Black in Jayanagar: expects 9.6 units in 14 days (P10 4.4, P90 15.0). Drivers: sales momentum -9%, festivals and events -8%, recent sales level +7%. Sizes with no stock: L.

steps.thought: Coquette is emerging. Check that the forecast for an exposed coquette product reflects it.
steps.observation: HALFDAY Cropped Baby Tee, Blue in Indiranagar: expects 21.3 units in 14 days (P10 11.9, P90 36.9). Drivers: product lifecycle +28%, style trend +21%, price and promotions +19%.

steps.thought: Draft the plan that meets every service-level target, ignoring budget, to see what full protection costs.
steps.observation: Move 522 units over 24 lanes (Rs 18,498); order 2,798 units on 508 lines for Rs 19.9L. Expected unmet demand over 14 days falls from 1,000 to 208 units.

steps.thought: Verify the draft against the operating guardrails before committing anything.
steps.observation: Failed: Weekly supplier budget: Rs 1,988,712 exceeds the Rs 1,800,000 cap by Rs 188,712. Redraft with budget=1800000.

steps.thought: The draft costs Rs 19.9L, above the Rs 18.0L weekly cap. Redraft under the cap; units are then bought in order of expected margin per rupee, so the cut removes the units least likely to sell.
steps.observation: Move 522 units over 24 lanes (Rs 18,498); order 2,572 units on 503 lines for Rs 18.0L. Budget is binding. Expected unmet demand over 14 days falls from 1,000 to 225 units.

steps.thought: Verify the draft against the operating guardrails before committing anything.
steps.observation: All 7 checks passed. 1 warning(s): Anomaly exposure.

steps.thought: Look at the other side of the shelf: stock that demand will not clear, which ties up cash the plan needs.
steps.observation: 55 product-store pairs hold more than 12 weeks of cover, worth Rs 3.5L.

steps.thought: The draft passes every hard check. Commit it and route exceptions to a person.
steps.observation: Committed 503 order lines (480 approved automatically, 23 queued for review, Rs 3.2L) and 383 transfer moves on 24 lanes.

tools.name: network_overview
tools.description: Network status on the as-of date: demand over the last 28 days and the forecast for the next 28, by store and by category, plus the events coming up. Start here.

tools.name: scan_anomalies
tools.description: Recent demand anomalies at city, store and product level, each with its known cause or marked unexplained. Unexplained spikes can inflate a product's run-rate and its forecast.

tools.name: scan_trends
tools.description: Styles, colours, fits and product types whose share of demand is moving, with statistical significance and the leading social buzz signal for styles.

tools.name: scan_stockout_risk
tools.description: Products most likely to run out, ranked by expected lost revenue. horizon 'week' covers the days before a supplier order can arrive; 'cycle' covers the full 14-day protection interval.

tools.name: explain_forecast
tools.description: Forecast for one product in one store: run-rate, forecast with interval, what drives it, and the size-level stock position.

tools.name: find_overstock
tools.description: Products holding far more stock than forecast demand needs: candidates for markdown or for moving to a store that sells them.

tools.name: draft_plan
tools.description: Draft an inventory plan: store-to-store transfers (optimised) then supplier orders up to the service-level target. Pass a budget in INR to cap supplier spend; units are then bought in order of expected margin per rupee. Replaces any earlier draft.

tools.name: check_guardrails
tools.description: Check the current draft against the operating guardrails (budget, donor protection, lane capacity, forecast sanity). A plan with a failed check cannot be committed.

tools.name: commit_plan
tools.description: Commit the draft. Lines within limits are approved automatically; large or uncertain lines are queued for human review. Fails if a guardrail check fails.
